verdict.rationale: DeepInfra officially documents and supports using the existing OpenAI SDK against its endpoint by changing only the base_url, api_key and model. That gives developers a supported SDK path, but no first-party DeepInfra SDK is shown. The OpenAPI 3.1 spec and Swagger UI are building blocks, not SDKs, so they add no credit here. Missing for 10: a first-party DeepInfra SDK in any language, SDK docs for non-chat surfaces (deployments, GPU rentals, image/video), SDK versioning or changelog, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Point your existing OpenAI SDK to `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai` and your code works without changes. No migration required.
